gate_note: The first gate (+20 points overall inside fraction) was mis-designed: annulus and saddle vertices lie ON the base plane by construction, so ~100% inside is not attainable for a correctly seated valve. Replaced by the leaflet-zone criterion, stated before evaluation.

residual_analysis_refit_v1.interpretation: Residual is shallow (top 7 mm of the leaflet zone), small (median 1.5 mm beyond the wall, vs 8.8 mm for the original) and concentrated in one 45-degree sector (46%). The LV basal cross-section is elliptical (LV extents 66x82 mm); the generated valve is round, so it protrudes only along the short axis. Fix for a v2: orient the generator's D-shape factor to the LV basal cross-section principal axes.

decision: refit_v1 NOT promoted to canonical mitral_valve.stl (leaflet criterion 87.5% < 90%). Written alongside as mitral_valve_refit_v1.stl / aortic_valve_refit_v1.stl. Recommended for printing: refit_v1 -- every metric improves and the residual is 1.5 mm, one-sided, shallow. The original is 60 degrees misoriented and should not be printed as anatomy.
